method: Private source numerical functions versus independently authored SVG/HTML recurrences

results.scope: Private unmodified source update functions versus independent numerical recurrences: 300 updates for every original single mass/k or energy level; min/mid/max release positions and angles; both authored normal-mode starts; 16 phase-oscillator model/damping/position tuples. Mixed continuous drag histories and all simultaneous mass/k combinations remain unexhausted.
